action.title: Action
action.description: What to do. comps/stats need no login; inbox/reply/post/update_price/delist use the stored session.
enumTitles: reply: send a message in a conversation
stats: views / favorites of a listing
update_price: change the price of an ad (browser)

limit.title: Max results (comps)
limit.description: comps: number of listings to return (1-300).

categoryId.title: L1 category id (comps)
categoryId.description: comps: optional Marktplaats L1 category id to narrow the search.

includeNoPrice.title: Include listings without a price (comps)
includeNoPrice.description: comps: also return 'Bieden' / 'Zie omschrijving' listings that have no amount.

excludeBusiness.title: Exclude business ads (comps)
excludeBusiness.description: comps: skip Admarkt ads (ids starting with 'a': shops, auction houses), which distort second-hand prices.

since.title: Since (inbox)
since.description: inbox: ISO timestamp. Only conversations/bids with activity after this moment are returned; messages after it are flagged isNew.

conversationLimit.title: Max conversations (inbox)
conversationLimit.description: inbox: newest N conversations to read.

includeBids.title: Include bids (inbox)
includeBids.description: inbox: read the bids on your own active listings and attach them (bid-only entries too).

sellingOnly.title: Only conversations where I sell (inbox)
sellingOnly.description: inbox: skip conversations about things you are buying.

conversationId.title: Conversation id (reply)
conversationId.description: reply: conversationId from the inbox output.

replyMode.title: Reply mode
replyMode.description: reply: 'http' (fast, internal endpoint), 'browser' (types into the chat UI), or 'auto' (http, falls back to browser on a non-auth failure).

listingUrl.title: Listing URL (stats)
listingUrl.description: stats: full listing URL. Alternatively pass listingId.

listingId.title: Listing id
listingId.description: stats / update_price / delist: listing id, e.g. 'm2446876735'.

delistReason.title: Delist reason
delistReason.description: delist: which answer to pick in the 'why are you removing this ad' dialog.

description.title: Description (post)
description.description: post: ad description (plain text, newlines kept).

price.title: Price in euros (post / update_price)
price.description: post / update_price: asking price in whole euros.

allowBids.title: Allow bids (post)
allowBids.description: post: with Vraagprijs, tick 'Bieden toestaan' so buyers can bid.

categoryHint.title: Category hint (post)
categoryHint.description: post: text to match against the categories Marktplaats suggests for the title, e.g. 'Fauteuils'. The first suggestion is used when nothing matches.

photoUrls.title: Photos (post)
photoUrls.description: post: photo URLs (https://...) or keys in the photo KV store (see photoStore). Max 24.

condition.title: Condition (post)
condition.description: post: new | as_good_as_new | used | refurbished | not_working, or the Dutch label as shown on the form.

delivery.title: Delivery (post)
delivery.description: post: pickup (Ophalen), shipping (Verzenden) or both (Ophalen of Verzenden).

postcode.title: Postcode (post)
postcode.description: post: only used when the form's postcode is empty.

attributes.title: Extra attributes (post)
attributes.description: post: category-specific fields, keyed by form label or field name, e.g. {"Merk": "IKEA", "Kleur": "Bruin"}.

dryRun.title: Dry run (post / update_price / delist)
dryRun.description: Fill everything and take screenshots, but do not click the final place / save / delete button.

useProxy.title: Use residential NL proxy
useProxy.description: Route traffic through Apify RESIDENTIAL proxy with countryCode NL.

sessionStore.title: Session KV store
sessionStore.description: Named key-value store holding the Playwright storageState under key 'state'.

photoStore.title: Photo KV store
photoStore.description: Named key-value store used when a photo entry is a key instead of a URL.

headful.title: Headful browser (local debugging)
headful.description: Show the browser window. Only useful with 'apify run' on your own machine.
